Not accessible to touch or screen-reader users by design — preview cards are a progressive enhancement over the underlying link, which remains fully operable on its own. Prop Type Default open / defaultOpen boolean false onOpenChange (open: boolean) => void — HoverCardTrigger Renders a real link () and needs an href — preview cards exist to preview link destinations.
